code_examples.title: 批量统计FASTQ文件序列数
code_examples.code:
#!/bin/bash
# 批量统计FASTQ文件序列数

for file in *.fastq; do
    echo "Processing: $file"
    count=$(($(cat "$file" | wc -l) / 4))
    echo "$file: $count sequences"
done

code_examples.title: ggplot2数据处理与可视化
code_examples.code:
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# 数据处理练习
data %>%
  filter(condition == "treatment") %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_val = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = mean_val, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - sd_val, ymax = mean_val + sd_val)) +
  theme_bw()

code_examples.title: RNA-seq前处理流程
code_examples.code:
# 完整的RNA-seq前处理流程

# 1. 质量控制
mkdir -p 01_qc
fastqc -o 01_qc -t 4 sample_R1.fastq.gz sample_R2.fastq.gz
multiqc 01_qc -o 01_qc

# 2. 去接头和质量过滤
mkdir -p 02_clean
trimmomatic PE -threads 4 \
    sample_R1.fastq.gz sample_R2.fastq.gz \
    02_clean/sample_R1.clean.fastq.gz 02_clean/sample_R1.unpair.fastq.gz \
    02_clean/sample_R2.clean.fastq.gz 02_clean/sample_R2.unpair.fastq.gz \
    ILLUMINACLIP:TruSeq3-PE.fa:2:30:10 \
    LEADING:3 TRAILING:3 SLIDINGWINDOW:4:15 MINLEN:36

# 3. 比对到参考基因组
mkdir -p 03_alignment
hisat2 -x genome_index \
    -1 02_clean/sample_R1.clean.fastq.gz \
    -2 02_clean/sample_R2.clean.fastq.gz \
    -S 03_alignment/aligned.sam \
    --new-summary -p 4

# 4. SAM转BAM并排序
samtools view -bS 03_alignment/aligned.sam | \
    samtools sort -o 03_alignment/aligned.sorted.bam
samtools index 03_alignment/aligned.sorted.bam

# 5. 统计比对率
samtools flagstat 03_alignment/aligned.sorted.bam

code_examples.title: DESeq2差异分析
code_examples.code:
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)

# 1. 读取count矩阵和临床信息
counts <- read.csv("counts.csv", row.names = 1)
coldata <- read.csv("metadata.csv", row.names = 1)
coldata$group <- factor(coldata$group)

# 2. 创建DESeq对象
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ group
)

# 3. 差异分析
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("group", "treatment", "control"))

curriculum.title: 项目2 - RNA-seq差异表达分析（下）

tasks.desc: 博客：《RNA-seq差异表达分析完整教程》

code_examples.title: 差异分析可视化
code_examples.code:
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

# 4. 显著性筛选
res_sig <- res[res$padj < 0.05 & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1, ]
res_sig <- res_sig[order(res_sig$padj), ]

# 5. 火山图
ggplot(as.data.frame(res), aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw()

# PCA图
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "group", returnData = TRUE)
ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw()

code_examples.title: GATK前处理
code_examples.code:
# GATK变异检测流程

# 1. 构建BWA索引
bwa index ref.fa

# 2. 比对
bwa mem -t 8 -R "@RG\tID:sample\tSM:sample\tPL:ILLUMINA" \
    ref.fa sample_R1.fq.gz sample_R2.fq.gz | \
    samtools sort -o sample.sorted.bam

# 3. 标记重复
gatk MarkDuplicates -I sample.sorted.bam -O sample.dedup.bam \
    -M metrics.txt

# 4. BQSR
gatk BaseRecalibrator -I sample.dedup.bam -R ref.fa \
    --known-sites dbsnp.vcf -O recal.table
gatk ApplyBQSR -I sample.dedup.bam -R ref.fa \
    --bqsr-recal-file recal.table -O sample.recal.bam

tasks.desc: 博客：《GATK变异检测实战指南》

code_examples.title: GATK变异检测与注释
code_examples.code:
# 5. 变异检测（HaplotypeCaller）
gatk HaplotypeCaller -R ref.fa -I sample.recal.bam \
    -O raw_variants.vcf

# 6. 变异过滤
gatk VariantFiltration -R ref.fa -V raw_variants.vcf \
    --filter-expression "QD < 2.0 || MQ < 40.0 || FS > 60.0 || SOR > 3.0" \
    --filter-name "FAIL" \
    -O filtered_variants.vcf

# 7. 提取PASS变异
bcftools view -f PASS filtered_variants.vcf -o variants_pass.vcf

# 8. 注释
java -Xmx4g -jar snpEff.jar GRCh38.86 variants_pass.vcf > annotated.vcf

code_examples.title: ChIP-seq比对
code_examples.code:
# ChIP-seq分析流程

# 1. 质控和比对
fastqc chip.fastq.gz input.fastq.gz
bowtie2 -x genome -U chip.fastq.gz -S chip.sam --no-mixed
bowtie2 -x genome -U input.fastq.gz -S input.sam --no-mixed

# SAM转BAM
samtools view -bS chip.sam | samtools sort -o chip.bam
samtools view -bS input.sam | samtools sort -o input.bam
samtools index chip.bam input.bam

# 2. Peak calling (MACS2)
macs2 callpeak -t chip.bam -c input.bam \
    -f BAM -g hs -n sample \
    --outdir peaks \
    --qvalue 0.01

code_examples.title: GEO数据挖掘
code_examples.code:
library(GEOquery)
library(limma)
library(tidyverse)

# 1. 下载GEO数据
gset <- getGEO("GSE12345", GSEMatrix = TRUE, getGPL = FALSE)
expr <- exprs(gset[[1]])
pdata <- pData(gset[[1]])

# 2. 差异分析
group <- ifelse(grepl("tumor", pdata$title), "tumor", "normal")
design <- model.matrix(~0+group)
colnames(design) <- c("normal", "tumor")

fit <- lmFit(expr, design)
contrast <- makeContrasts(tumor - normal, levels = design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# 3. 筛选差异基因
diff_genes <- topTable(fit2, number = Inf, p.value = 0.05)

code_examples.title: 单细胞降维聚类
code_examples.code:
library(Seurat)
library(harmony)

# 4. 降维
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, npcs = 50)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- RunTSNE(pbmc, dims = 1:30)

# 5. 聚类
pbmc <- pbmc %>% 
  RunHarmony(group.by.vars = "orig.ident") %>%
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5)

# 6. Marker基因鉴定
markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25)
top_markers <- markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(10, avg_log2FC)

# 8. 可视化
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top_markers$gene)
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("CD3D", "MS4A1", "CD14"))

tasks.desc: 博客：《多组学数据整合分析案例》

code_examples.title: 生存分析
code_examples.code:
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# 1. 下载多组学数据
query_exp <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-LUAD",
                      data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling")
exp_data <- GDCprepare(query_exp)

query_cli <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-LUAD",
                      data.category = "Clinical")
cli_data <- GDCprepare(query_cli)

# 2. 生存分析
surv_data <- cli_data[, c("submitter_id", "vital_status", "days_to_death")]
surv_data$time <- ifelse(surv_data$vital_status == "Dead",
                         surv_data$days_to_death, NA)
surv_data$event <- ifelse(surv_data$vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0)

fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ group, data = surv_data)
ggsurvplot(fit, data = surv_data, pval = TRUE)
